remarks: Welcome to West Park Commons, located just steps from Stamford's vibrant downtown. This stunning 3 bedroom, 3.5 bath modern townhome, built in 2017, offers the perfect blend of style, convenience and luxurious comfort. With an open floor plan, designer finishes, hardwood floors, crown molding and recessed lighting throughout, this gem delivers exceptional living at every turn. The main level features a spacious, gorgeous kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and an abundance of cabinet storage which flows seamlessly into both the dining room and the large living room with balcony access. The upper level includes two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bath for added privacy plus easy access to laundry in the hallway. The expansive primary suite occupies its own floor, creating a serene, retreat-like space ideal for relaxation as well as being versatile to suit your needs. Additional highlights include an attached 2-car garage with ample storage, central air and gas heat. This townhome offers unmatched convenience, all within walking distance to Stamford's best dining, shops, bars and nightlife, plus 2 short blocks to Mill River Park and minutes to I-95 and the train station. Do not miss out on this like-new construction in the most prime location!
